text: The three story files 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Service Story Files v1/RWB-SVC-P4 rwb-access (Access and authority)/RWB P4 AD006 APP Break-glass access v1.md, RWB P4 AD006 CON Break-glass access - contract v1.md and RWB P4 AD006 DB Break-glass access - ACE DB v1.md, and the fragments _work/msr/fragments/RWB-P4-AD006-APP.json, RWB-P4-AD006-CON.json and RWB-P4-AD006-DB.json, all already present in the tree and written by the parallel Work Package B-P4-02 for the same three slices of legacy RWB-AD-006, stand as the deliverable of B2-P4-005: they are not rewritten, not versioned to v2, not duplicated, and their missing values stay registered once as CG-B-P4-02-AD006-1, -2 and -3 with ASM-B-P4-02-AD006-1 to -10. Their metadata rows, their 19 sections, AC1 to AC3 of RWB-AD-006 with the origin tags and the one mock Given line on the APP file, the seven (new, D-RCV-60) criteria of each of the CON and DB files, the five legacy test case IDs TC-AD-006-01 to TC-AD-006-05 with the Level column, the section 12 tables 12.1 to 12.9, the fragment keys and the citation set are kept unchanged, and B2-P4-005 registers only the duplicate-Work-Package finding.
why: The Work Package names the three story files and the three fragments as its outputs and every one of them already exists with complete content, because the plan issues two Work Packages for one legacy key (B-P4-02 with fanout 5 and B2-P4-005 with fanout 0) and the earlier of them ran. Root AGENTS.md rule 1 forbids editing a file that already exists and forbids writing a path outside the 'Write only' block, so the next-version copy that rule 1 would otherwise ask for cannot be created here (a v2 file is not a listed output), and rule 13 forbids stopping the run. The existing artefacts were therefore read, verified against Template and Rules v1 R7, R7.1, R7.2, R8.1 and R9, against the P4 context pack and against the legacy story RWB-AD-006 with the FSD and TSD P4 v3 module files, and kept, and the collision is recorded as one gap row and this row, in the same way as the parallel B2-P4-002 finding and the other B2 collisions of this run.
read: _work/msr/wp/B-P4-02.md and _work/msr/wp/B2-P4-005.md (the same six output paths); _work/msr/plan/split_plan.json (three slices for RWB-AD-006); _work/msr/context/P4.md (service row, ownership rows, DP short table, slides); 22 Microservice Realignment/Recovery Workbench Microservice Story Template and Rules v1.md (R5.3, R5.4, R5.5, R5.6, R5.7, R6, R7.1, R7.2, R8.1, R9); 04 User stories/Recovery Workbench Administration Stories v3.md heading RWB-AD-006; _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Functional Specifications by Module v6/Recovery Workbench FSD P4 Access and administration v3.md (A2.9 and A2.10, AC-ALT-P4-009-01, AC-EXC-P4-009-01 to -07, REQ-ACA-008); _work/msr/extract/Recovery Workbench Technical Specifications by Module v5/Recovery Workbench TSD P4 Access and administration v3.md (API-P4-008, API-P4-012, API-P4-013, appendix T-A.2); the three delivered story files and the three delivered fragments; _work/msr/gaps/B-P4-02-AD006.part.jsonl and _work/msr/assumptions/B-P4-02-AD006.part.jsonl.
applied_in: B2-P4-005: the six artefacts left unchanged, no value re-registered and no row duplicated; _work/msr/gaps/B2-P4-005.jsonl (1 row); _work/msr/assumptions/B2-P4-005.jsonl (1 row); _work/msr/editlog/B2-P4-005.md
confirm: Delivery lead and the stage B2 coordinator at the wave 4 batch close, when the plan is de-duplicated and the B-P4-02 title is closed with its edit log row
impact: If the coordinator instead wants B2-P4-005 to own the three files, they must be rewritten from legacy RWB-AD-006 with a new set of citations of the form CG-B2-P4-005-n, which invalidates the 13 identifiers the delivered artefacts cite and the cross-references the sibling files RWB P4 AD002, AD003, AD004 and AD005 carry, and gains no content beyond shorter files (the style aim of 20-25 KB per file in the Work Package is not met: the three files are 66,836, 49,098 and 43,555 bytes); if that is chosen, the three B-P4-02 AD006 gap rows and its ten assumption rows must be retired rather than numbered beside the new set at step D1. If the artefacts stand, the only exposure is that their CG and ASM citations carry a B-P4-02 prefix, so step D1 must number them from the two B-P4-02 AD006 part files and not from this Work Package's register.
